description:
Description
MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.
The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.
That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.
mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide , including at Fortune 500 companies .
The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. title: Builder
description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

WHAT WE MEAN BY BUILDER

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

 

WHAT A WEEK CAN LOOK LIKE

- A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy

- A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning

- Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else.

- You've built something people used and owned the outcome: as a founder, in a fast-growing product team, or with a side project that you launched.

- You have commercial sense and product taste. Agency and taste are the main differentiators in today's AGI age.

- You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default and you've made something real with them that wouldn't exist otherwise.

- You have strong technical intuition: you reason about data and systems rather than getting caught up in the details of code.

- You're comfortable in front of industrial customers. You are fluent in German; English is strong plus.

- You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

- Early in your career? Great. We love to bet on people with a steep learning curve.

 

HOW THE PROCESS WORKS

1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

HOW WE WORK

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

OUR BACKGROUND

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

title: Senior Integrated Producer
description:
Great creative work takes more than a great idea. It takes people who know how to bring that idea to life across different channels, disciplines and teams.

A single campaign might involve film, websites, digital experiences, social content, print, experiential activations and dozens of individual deliverables. Each has its own requirements, timelines and production challenges. Making them all work together takes experience, judgement and an understanding of how things get made.

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Producer who can bring all of that together. Someone who sees the bigger picture, connects the right people and knows how to turn ambitious creative ideas into exceptional work.

You'll be the connective tissue between teams, disciplines and deliverables. You'll know when to bring in the right experts, recognize when something isn't working and understand which levers to pull to get things back on track.

About ICF & ICF Next
ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.

ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.
We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.

We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.

Our Creative team brings together more than 150 professionals across design, copy, video, motion, production and operations. We work across disciplines to deliver ambitious, effective and beautifully executed work.

The Role
As a Senior Integrated Producer, you'll take ownership of complex, multichannel campaigns, working across Creative, Account, Strategy, Digital and specialist production teams to bring ideas from the initial brief through development, production, launch and delivery.
You'll understand how the different elements of a campaign fit together, what each discipline needs to succeed and how decisions in one area can affect the wider work.

You'll have a strong working knowledge of digital production, including websites, interactive experiences, digital advertising and content platforms, alongside film, video, motion, print, experiential and other channels. You don't need to be a technical specialist in every area, but you do need to understand how things work, recognize potential gaps and know when to involve the right experts.

You'll be expected to make decisions, challenge assumptions and help teams navigate the realities of complex production. When something isn't working, you'll understand why and know what needs to change, whether that's the resources, the schedule, the scope or the way teams are working together.

This is a senior role for someone who can bring clarity to complexity, keep people connected and make sure the work delivers on its creative ambition.

What You'll Do

•
Bring it all together. Lead the planning and delivery of integrated campaigns across digital, social, film, video, motion, print, experiential and emerging channels. Understand how individual deliverables connect and make sure the entire campaign works as a cohesive whole.

•
Connect the teams. Work across Creative, Account, Strategy, Digital and specialist production teams. Establish clear responsibilities, keep people aligned and know when to bring in the right expertise.

•
Know how things get made. Bring a broad understanding of production across channels, with particularly strong digital knowledge. Recognize the technical requirements, dependencies and potential gaps, and work with specialists to find the right solutions.

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. THE TEAM

Every parcel ends at a door. Where that door is, where a courier can park, and which way they walk in decide whether a handover takes seconds or minutes, and whether anyone ends up at the wrong place at all. Most of that never shows up on a map.

Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. Location intelligence is where it starts.

LOCATION INTELLIGENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- Telematics from the couriers who deliver for us: GPS traces, stops, parking spots and building entrances, all from live deliveries.

- Mapping and road networks: where addresses and front doors really are, and how roads and traffic really behave.

- A foundation layer: your work feeds routing, optimisation and courier intelligence, and gives our decision teams the evidence to tell a wrong address from a failed handover.

- One of the first hires into Relay's new Location Intelligence team, with room to set the direction.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence at Relay, you'll:

- Lead location intelligence at Relay, turning telematics and map data into a trusted picture of where deliveries really happen.

- Build the methods that find the front door: map matching, stop and dwell detection, and parking and entrance inference from messy GPS traces.

- Model road networks, traffic and travel times, so routes and plans reflect how the city really moves.

- Take models from prototype to production, and own their quality once they are live.

- Partner with Operational Research, Courier Intelligence and Engineering so correct addresses and doors flow into routing and decisions.

- Raise the standard for location science at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have hands-on experience with telematics or GPS data: individual traces, map matching, and stop or dwell detection.

- Have worked on a mapping or location product, whether an online maps platform or an internal mapping product for a delivery or mobility app.

- Come from a STEM background, with strong statistics and solid data and coding fundamentals.

- Have shipped location models into production, and owned them after launch.

- Have set technical direction that others worked to, and brought people with them.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

- Aim with Preci
